rca of the issue: Root cause: in iteration_8 source change, linerShort() was refactored and a companion mediumShort() was referenced on line 449 of QuoteTableSec.jsx but never defined in the same module. Because ComponentLayout renders eagerly on any MP-Individual quote, this threw ReferenceError synchronously, causing React's error boundary fallback (the CRA dev-overlay) to take the entire viewport. Additionally, linerShort('None') passed the literal string through, violating legacy fmLnr semantics (None → Kraft). Fix: defined mediumShort() with the legacy ' Medium'/' Bleached Medium' suffix stripping (matches the PDF preview implementation in PreviewPdfModal.jsx lines 93-103); rewrote linerShort() to treat falsy OR literal 'None' as Kraft and to strip the weight prefix + -Lite/-White suffixes consistently. Reproduction (before fix): log in as admin → loaded quote auto-renders the MP-Individual ComponentLayout → page-level Uncaught runtime errors overlay. Mitigation (applied): replaced both helper functions in /app/frontend/src/components/spot/QuoteTableSec.jsx — frontend hot-reloaded and the live SA-260604-155037 quote now renders with all 5 refinements per spec.
